hello.note: No native hello; at a door say kula nuwun.

good_morning.note: The e in sugeng is a quick uh, as in 'about'.

good_evening.note: From late afternoon; after dark, sugeng dalu.

goodbye.note: To the one leaving; if you go, say kula pamit.

slang.note: Ngoko, everyday; friends and peers only.

thank_you.note: Used by everyone; the casual short form is suwun.

youre_welcome.note: Reply to thanks, literally 'the same to you'.

slang.note: Ngoko; friends and peers, common in East Java.

no_problem.note: Ngoko for 'it's nothing'; polite is mboten menapa-menapa.

please.note: Asks for help; mangga (MAHNG-gah) is 'go ahead'.

excuse_me.note: 'A thousand pardons'; also softens a request.

sorry.note: Polite; nuwun sewu also serves as an apology.

yes.note: Polite yes; among friends it is iya (EE-yah).

no.note: Polite no; among friends it is ora (OH-rah).

of_course.note: Casual certainly; more formal is mesthi kemawon.

amazing.note: 'Really good' - casual, and what you will hear.

delicious.note: The final k is a soft catch, not a hard k.

cheers.note: Not a Javanese custom; the English word, or bersulang.
